summary.intent: Introduce a single Git output boundary in callisto-model (typed line/path/NUL-framed records plus a Pathspec newtype), migrate all Git-reading callers, and fix the changeset PR link bug for subjects containing U+0001 or non-ASCII/quoted file names, with a patch changeset, gated and pushed as a PR.
summary.outcome: Added vcs/boundary.rs (GitStdout, LogEntry, Pathspec), migrated callers in model and graph, removed literal_pathspec and CommandOutput::stdout_line, fixed changeset_prs with a test-first approach, and added a patch changeset. Lint, test, doc-check and pre-push were run; the reviewer's --no-show-signature finding was fixed and committed. Mutants left 19 survivors that were not addressed, and the merge of origin/main, push, trail link, ci-pr and lead report were not completed.

repo: AGENTS.md invariant ladder: type or private constructor first, then exhaustive match, lint, then one boundary test; delete redundant per-call-site checks and migrate all siblings.

An architecture test (release_modules_never_discard_error_sources in callisto-graph/tests/architecture.rs) rejects `|_|` error-discarding closures in release modules; `|_failed|` also tripped it, so failed-command branches had to stay explicit.
git log -z --name-only emits no blank field between commits, so a leading %x00 per commit (built by LogEntry::format) is needed to frame records; U+0001 framing was the cause of the dropped PR links.
Git log honors log.showSignature, so changeset PR reads need --no-show-signature or the output is corrupted.
cargo-mutants tests only the mutated crate, so functions whose only callers are in other crates survive unless real-Git tests live in the same crate.
Version tests mock git args, so adding -z to ls-tree required updating the expected args in commands/version/tests.rs.

code.finding: New module holding GitStdout (of, fields, path, into_text, log_entries), LogEntry with format(), and Pathspec::literal; the single Git output boundary.
literal_pathspec and RECORD_SEP removed; files_containing_at now takes &[Pathspec]; readers use GitStdout::of with error mapping.
Rewritten to use LogEntry::format(["%s"]) with NUL framing instead of U+0001, fixing the dropped link bug.

workflow: Python edit scripts with assert on match counts made large multi-site migrations safe.
Writing scripts to files under target/ avoided worktree-guard issues with inline shell.
Sandbox blocks gpg keybox access, so signed commits needed retrying outside the sandbox.
Running a fresh reviewer subagent early surfaced a real regression (showSignature) before gates finished.
Long gates run with output redirected to log files and checked by exit code.

friction: Signed commit initially failed because the sandbox blocked gpg's keybox.
Initial -z log format assumption was wrong and required experiments with real git and a redesign of the framing.
The architecture test failed on the `|_failed|` closure rename, costing a lint/test rerun cycle.
One npm test is blocked by the sandbox.
cargo mutants left 19 survivors, mostly in functions called only from other crates.
Concurrent cargo build limits (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=3) slowed gates.
open_items: 19 surviving mutants were not killed; the task requires zero missed or argued equivalents in the PR body.
The origin/main merge, gate re-run if it moved, push, ls-remote confirmation, trail link, ci-pr, handling of Entire findings and the final report to close-gap-for-alpha remain undone.
The transcript indicates the lead cut ceremony, so the mutants requirement should be confirmed with the lead.
The npm test blocked by the sandbox is unverified and should be reported.
